title: Scientists Who Use AI Win Big, But Science Is Quietly Losing
description:
Turns out the scientists who lean hardest on AI are climbing the career ladder way faster than everyone else. 🔥 The University of Chicago went through fourty million papers from the last fifty years, and the pattern is kinda wild. AI adopters publish 3x more, pull 5x the citations and grab leadership roles a year or two early.

But heres the catch. Their work sticks to popular topics with ready made datasets, and almost never touches anything new. So everyone wins on paper 😅 while science as a whole slowly gets more one note ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
